title: Type-I CGX Evidence Maturity and Invalidation Graph
purpose: Join the existing archetype matrix, component-instance binding states, equation/volumetric kernels, directional stack resolver, seed topology and P0-P10 proof ladder into one non-authority maturity state machine. New sources or measurements may advance only the dimensions they prove; changed evidence invalidates dependent inferences without erasing history.

owners.rule: This contract does not replace owner engineering records. It provides a deterministic projection of evidence state and dependency invalidation.

object_factorization: Archetype × Instance × PrimitiveKernel × VolumetricKernel × InterfaceOperator × ProcessSequence × FunctionalVoxelState × SeedGraph × FieldCoupling × WitnessEvidence × AuthorityCeiling

maturity_states.name: DISCOVERED
maturity_states.minimum: Stable object/archetype identity may exist; consequential source/geometry/material/process claims remain unresolved.

maturity_states.name: SOURCE_ATTRIBUTED
maturity_states.minimum: Attributable source or measured reference bound with revision/hash/locator.

maturity_states.name: GEOMETRY_RESOLVED
maturity_states.minimum: Exact package/CAD/BREP/measured geometry revision, dimensions/interfaces and tolerances are bound within source scope.

maturity_states.name: MATERIAL_RESOLVED
maturity_states.minimum: Actual material identity, lot/passport and consequential interfaces/interlayers are bound.

maturity_states.name: PROCESS_RESOLVED
maturity_states.minimum: Directional build/assembly sequence, environment, activation/post-process and prior-layer damage/preservation checks are bound.

maturity_states.name: TESTABLE
maturity_states.minimum: Acceptance tests, instruments/calibration, falsifiers, failure modes and uncertainty method are defined before build.

maturity_states.name: DIGITALLY_BUILD_READY
maturity_states.minimum: Manufacturability/tool/safety/authority gates pass for the declared low-consequence scope. This is not proof of fabrication.

maturity_states.name: AS_BUILT_CAPTURED
maturity_states.minimum: Exact configuration/source hashes, execution/process history and as-built identity are recorded.

maturity_states.name: MEASURED
maturity_states.minimum: Physical readback exists with calibration provenance, raw values, uncertainty and declared environment.

maturity_states.name: REVIEWED_WITHIN_SCOPE
maturity_states.minimum: Measured evidence has been compared to the frozen baseline/objective and reviewed. Certification/release remain separate authorities.

maturity_vector_axes.question: Is the object/revision/hash lineage unambiguous and read back?
Are source facts attributable to exact revision/lot where required?
Is the consequential 3D topology, dimension/tolerance and interface geometry resolved?
Is X→Y build order, environment, activation and preservation resolved?
Is the governing equation/field/constitutive model valid for this regime and configuration?
Are tests, instruments, calibration, uncertainty and falsifiers bound?
Has the exact article been built and measured?
Are consequential pair/hyperedge couplings and fault interactions evidenced?
Is the requested use within owner/safety/certification/publication authority?

projection_policy.no_single_score: Do not average maturity axes into a universal percentage. A claim is limited by the lowest required axis and any hard stop gate.
projection_policy.claim_floor: For a requested claim, evaluate only the axes/edges required by that claim, then use the minimum supported evidence ceiling across them.
projection_policy.child_ceiling: Integration can never raise the evidence ceiling of a child component, interface or seed.
projection_policy.certification: A certified seed keeps its own certification scope; printed surroundings do not inherit it.
projection_policy.digital_physical: Schema, CI, simulation, render, equation or AI consensus cannot advance physical_evidence beyond M6.
projection_policy.measured_review: M8 requires measurements; M9 additionally requires bounded review against the frozen baseline/objective.

seed_graphs.name: SEEDLESS
seed_graphs.definition: No embedded imported specialist component is required for the declared function.
seed_graphs.maturity_rule: All required active/passive mechanisms must be supported by locally qualified material/process/test evidence; absence of a seed cannot be used to infer capability.

seed_graphs.name: SINGLE_SEED
seed_graphs.definition: One imported/specialist seed island supplies a function while surrounding structure/interconnect/thermal/sensing/service geometry may be locally produced.
seed_graphs.maturity_rule: Track seed exact part/revision and every printed interface separately; seed evidence does not uplift surrounding geometry.

seed_graphs.name: MULTI_SEED
seed_graphs.definition: Multiple spatially distributed seeds are connected by printed/hybrid electrical, thermal, optical, fluidic, RF or structural geometry.
seed_graphs.maturity_rule: Track each seed and every consequential coupling edge. System maturity is bounded by the weakest required node/edge for the declared function.

functional_voxel_4d.state_form: X_v(t) = {geometry, material_state, environment, electrical, thermal, mechanical, magnetic, optical, fluidic, chemical/electrochemical, logic, calibration, health, uncertainty, history}
functional_voxel_4d.dynamics: E(x,p,t)·x_dot = F(x,u,p,t) within the validity domains of the participating physics kernels.
functional_voxel_4d.rule: Time/frequency/modal representations are views of an evolving 3D physical object; they are not additional spatial dimensions.
functional_voxel_4d.sparse_coupling: Only evidence-supported couplings are instantiated. Missing or unsupported coupling terms remain HOLD rather than being numerically invented.

regimes: full-wave optical/RF field solve when required
radiative_and_field_policy.energy_rule: Geometry redistributes/couples/stores/dissipates energy according to the governing physics; it does not create an absent source or active mechanism.
radiative_and_field_policy.capacitance_rule: Use closed forms only for attributable valid topologies; arbitrary 3D conductors require a Maxwell capacitance matrix or field solve with geometry/material/boundary revision binding.
radiative_and_field_policy.radiation_rule: Radiated or coupled power remains bounded by available source power, losses, aperture/coupling and environment; no unmeasured ambient-energy claim.

invalidate: derived numeric fixtures using changed inputs
preserve: prior source and results as historical lineage
material source identity unless independently changed

invalidate: process qualification tied to old lot
build-ready and physical equivalence where consequential

preserve: raw observations with explicit superseded calibration state
printed structure evidence not dependent on the seed change

invalidate: environment-specific properties, boundary conditions and tests
preserve: intrinsic source facts valid across the new regime only when their source scope explicitly permits it
both evidence branches, hashes, provenance and rejection rationale

contradiction_policy.resolution: Prefer higher-authority exact measured/source evidence only within its declared scope. Preserve conflicting evidence and dependency impact until review.
contradiction_policy.ai_rule: AI may propose reconciliation and affected-subgraph analysis but cannot erase evidence, invent missing measurements or promote authority.

proof_ladder_binding.rule: P0-P10 are representative physical proof stages, not maturity levels. An object can be digitally mature on some axes while physical proof remains NOT_RUN.
initial_priority: P3 resonator/loop only from measured P2 values
proof_ladder_binding.dense_integration: P10 may integrate only functions whose child evidence and consequential interfaces remain within their own proven envelopes.

type1_composition.aggregation_rule: No mean or majority vote. Every critical node, edge, safe-state path and required resource dependency must meet the maturity floor of the declared service.
type1_composition.degraded_operation: A Type-I capability may remain useful under degraded state only when reduced-function safe states and resource/repair dependencies are explicit and tested.
type1_composition.recursive_manufacturing: Parent-made mass/part/function fractions and critical imported dependencies remain explicit; recursion does not imply unlimited self-replication.

hard_boundaries: No physical execution is created by this contract.
No carrier/root promotion is created by this contract.
No public/certification/legal/financial/high-consequence authority is created by this contract.
No universal solver or universal-material compatibility claim.
No geometry-only inference of active semiconductor, battery chemistry, certified protection or biological effect.
Unknowns remain explicit and can only move by source, calculation in a valid regime, measured evidence or owner decision within scope.
